messages:
rachel: Heads-up — new enterprise POC. Federal customer requires fully air-gapped on-prem deployment. They want details on packaging, upgrade cadence, activation flow, and a pricing floor for offline support. Pilot target: 6 weeks. @jordan can you lead technical presales?

jordan: On it. Quick Qs to unblock scoping: max bundle size they'll accept? allowed physical media (USB vs DVD)? do they require signed bundles + SBOM? any hard constraints on live telemetry?

cheng: From ops side: our current airgap flow supports signed delta bundles + full bundle. Practical constraints: recommend <= 40GB full bundle for USB shipping; larger models need chunking. We can do chunked manifests with resume logic.

cheng: Example manifest snippet we use in the bundle (for ops):

```
manifest:
  bundles:
    - name: model-llama-q4
      parts: ["part-001", "part-002", "part-003"]
      checksum: sha256:... 
      signed_by: redwood-release
```

omar: Security notes: must have option to disable telemetry entirely (we can toggle at build time). Customer requires FIPS-validated crypto on the signing chain and acceptance testing for cert rotation without internet. Also require HSM/KMS integration for license activation — offline flow: customer generates CSR -> we sign activation token -> offline import.

linda: Legal/security questionnaire flagged: export classification for quantized models, chain-of-custody for physical media, and SLA credits for missed upgrade windows. We'll need to confirm commercial impact before giving a firm price.

jordan: Is there an ops-approved upgrade cadence we can commit to for the SOW? Customer wants monthly security updates but only quarterly feature updates. Can we do that?

cheng: Yes — we can offer security-only deltas monthly and feature deltas quarterly. Important caveat: delta generation for quantized weights requires an image rebuild step; timeline for a delta depends on model size (usually 48–72h).

rachel: Price question from buyer: what's the add-on for offline build/signing + on-site support window? Need a ballpark to work into negotiations.

linda: Ballpark commercial: one-time offline bundle service + signing: $30k–$50k depending on complexity. On-site support day rate separate. We'll refine after we get a BOM and acceptance criteria.

omar: Acceptance criteria (security): 1) capability to validate signed bundle with offline CA; 2) telemetry opt-out verified; 3) reproducible checksums; 4) cert rotation tested in staging. Ops acceptance items: 1) installer runs without external DNS; 2) chunked resume works for >2GB parts; 3) rollback path works within SLA.

jordan: Ops ask — can we get a list of model files they will include? If they plan to include any >20GB single artifact, we need to move to a multi-disk shipping plan.

rachel: I'll ask the customer for a BOM tonight. Also confirming pilot environment: 3 nodes, mixed GPU/CPU — they said they won't provide GPUs initially, so we may need to supply quantized model variants.

cheng: If GPUs absent, we strongly recommend int8 quant or GPTQ pack. Our offline tooling can produce quantized bundles but that adds a ~12–18h prebuild step and a small degradation risk. Need approval from ML lead.

omar: Security Q: if we produce quantized bundles externally, customer insists on reproducible build logs and provenance. We should offer SBOM + signed provenance tarball.

linda: I'll prepare a short addendum for the SOW with the pricing band and acceptance checklist. Need to confirm whether customer requires escrow of signing keys.

rachel: Action items: 1) I will get BOM + hardware matrix from customer (ETA: EOD). 2) @jordan to validate quantization acceptance with ML. 3) @cheng to confirm chunking/resume limits and confirm offline activation steps with eng. 4) @omar to draft security acceptance items we can include in questionnaire.

jordan: Acked. I'll ping ML team tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

cheng: I'll run a quick test of chunked install on our staging offline rig and post results here by Thurs.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window for staging airgap rig on 2026-03-27 02:00-04:00 UTC — good time to run tests.

rachel: Nice — thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for tracker. I'll drop the BOM when I have it.

omar: FYI — if they require HSM key custody, procurement lead time can be 6+ weeks; call that out in the SOW.

linda: Noted. Also adding clause: final price contingent on BOM + model classification.

rachel: Closing note: customer is sensitive about cartridge size and chain-of-custody. We'll push the chunked signed bundle approach as primary. Thanks team.
